answer:
Ollama runs Flint on macOS, Linux, and Windows, according to the newest release notes in the retrieved context that cover it (v0.40.9):

"[Flint](https://ollama.com/library/flint) now runs on Linux and Windows as well as macOS." [ollama/v0.40.9.md]

This supersedes the earlier v0.40.8 note, which said "Flint is supported on MacOS. Other GPU support will be enabled in a subsequent release." [ollama/v0.40.8.md]

The v0.40.12 notes mention Flint only for faster prompt processing on Apple silicon, and say nothing that changes platform support. I don't have the notes for v0.40.13, so I can't confirm whether that release changes anything.
